title: Upcoming IPOs, Explained Simply — November 2026
description: Crystal Crop Protection Limited's IPO is opening this week. Learn what an IPO is and why companies offer them.

faq.q: How do I even apply for an IPO?
faq.a: You can apply for an IPO through your bank's ASBA (Applications Supported by Blocked Amount) facility via net banking, or through your stockbroker's platform.
A lot size is the minimum number of shares you must bid for in an IPO. You cannot apply for shares individually; you must apply in multiples of this lot.
The price band is the fixed range (e.g., ₹259 to ₹272) within which you can place your bid for the shares. You can choose any price within this range.

The RHP (Red Herring Prospectus) or DRHP (Draft Red Herring Prospectus) is a detailed legal document filed by the company with SEBI, containing all essential information about the company, its finances, risks, and the IPO itself.

faq.q: What happens if an IPO is oversubscribed?
faq.a: If an IPO is oversubscribed (meaning more applications than available shares), shares are typically allotted to retail investors through a lottery system. If you get an allotment, shares are credited to your demat account; otherwise, your money is refunded.
